meta.title: Claude sidebar: Environment tab
meta.description: Adds an Environment tab showing the machine, folder, branch, context use, uncommitted changes, pull requests and connectors of the open session; the itsaplan card, branch-name check and work-tree progress file are optional task facts, off by default and configured on this row's Configure page in Plugins. It runs a few read-only git commands (including git status) in the session folder, reads dsh-oh-my-claude's context route when installed, and reconnects a server or stores a credential only when you click. It sends nothing outside dsh.
